summary: BTC ~$77.3k, -1.1% in 24h, set for a second straight red October (about -8% on the month). US spot BTC ETFs had $643M of outflows on 30 Oct, the biggest single-day exit since late June (IBIT -$234M, FBTC -$201M), on top of the Binance breach and a broad cross-asset selloff (Nasdaq -3%, gold and silver down). CFTC pointed to the hack to push voluntary exchange registration. Weekend, thin liquidity.
catalyst_note: US spot BTC ETF outflow $643M on 30 Oct, largest since June
